product: Share and govern Genie One skills with Unity Gateway (Beta)
tagline: You can now publish a skill from Genie One and share it with your team, governed by Unity Gateway.
what_it_does: You can now publish a skill from Genie One and share it with your team, governed by Unity Gateway. Access uses standard Unity Catalog privileges on the catalog and schema that hold the skill. A skill is a first class Unity Catalog securable in the three level namespace (catalog.schema.skill).
why_it_matters: You can now publish a skill from Genie One and share it with your team, governed by Unity Gateway.
